title: Selected Physical Input Variables for Symbolic Regression Discovery
rationale: Restricts equation search to 4 dimensionally well-scaled solid-state descriptors spanning barrier physics, electrostatic gating, interface de-pinning, and chemical bond formation. Prevents combinatorial explosion and division-by-zero or numerical underflow in genetic programming.

variables.physical_meaning: Schottky barrier height governing thermionic injection barrier
Electrostatic gate-induced channel carrier density modulating barrier width and tunneling
De-pinning binary flag indicating pristine van der Waals interface
Thermodynamic metal sulfide formation enthalpy indicating interface chemical bond energy
